prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1225; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports being struck on the driver side by a vehicle that entered the intersection against the signal. Claimant has no legal representation at this time. Initial call completed, statement recorded, and photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant reports neck strain with stiffness and reduced range of motion turning the head. Pain rated as moderate, worse in the mornings. Claimant has not yet seen a physician but states an appointment is scheduled. Advised claimant to keep all medical receipts and records. Requested authorization to obtain treatment records once visit is complete.

Entry 3: Reviewed police report, which notes the other driver was cited for failure to obey a traffic control device. Liability appears clear in favor of our insured. Scene photos and vehicle damage estimate received and placed in file. Other driver's carrier contacted to confirm coverage and open a parallel claim.

Entry 4: Followed up with claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed attending initial medical evaluation and was diagnosed with cervical strain. Prescribed physical therapy and over-the-counter anti-inflammatories. Claimant has not indicated any intention to retain counsel. Explained the claims process, timeline for property damage settlement, and the separate handling of the bodily injury portion.

Entry 5: Physical therapy notes received, indicating steady improvement over three sessions with reduced neck pain and improved mobility. Claimant reports returning to most daily activities but some discomfort with prolonged driving. Bodily injury evaluation is pending receipt of final treatment summary. Reserve reviewed and maintained pending medical closure. File remains open.
